hypothesis_verdicts.claim: Latent representations improve schizophrenia classification over raw edges.
hypothesis_verdicts.interpretation: Raw edges remain the conservative default overall; latent gains concentrate in specific forks such as ICA, OLS confounds, and partial correlation.

hypothesis_verdicts.claim: Between-domain edges show larger group-effect magnitude than within-domain edges.
hypothesis_verdicts.interpretation: Support is conditional on connectivity estimator: Pearson and Spearman are favourable, while partial correlation and mutual information are not.

hypothesis_verdicts.claim: Latent factors place greater loading mass on between-domain than within-domain edges.
hypothesis_verdicts.interpretation: The corrected direction-aware rule substantially weakens the earlier direction-blind count; H3 should be treated as exploratory.
